specialist.description: Everyone: start requests and work the tasks their skills qualify them for, for their own clients.

supervisor.description: Team lead, across all clients: rebalance work, cancel cases, correct plan records, review the audit log.

user-admin.description: Manage who can use Plan Ops Hub: import, activate and deactivate users.

integration-admin.description: Look after connected systems: test integration connections.

auditor.description: Read-only: see every client and plan, including restricted ones, and the full audit log; change nothing. Never routed work.
